title: The economy hides in plain sight. Who spots it first?
dek: Night lights, car parks, ship pings and search bars show the economy weeks before official data. What works, what flops, and a US and India pulse check.
blurb: Economists count cars from space, measure oil by its shadow and read a state's growth from its night lights. Six strange signals with what each sees and misses, RBI staff's lamplight test in three Indian states, America's busiest burger queue, a US and India pulse check, and a chart of which signals have earned trust.
cover_alt: The economy hides in plain sight. Who spots it first? A navy-to-dusk sky over a city skyline, with the KKReckons special report kicker.

title: Breaking, not ending: the week the systems failed
dek: Eight failures in six days, a viral doomsday hoax and AI that hacks at machine speed: what broke, what was attacked, and the fixes.
blurb: Email went dark, planes stood still, banks stalled, and the internet decided the world would end at 2:20 on Tuesday afternoon. It didn't. This report sorts what broke from what was attacked and what was just rumour, then looks at the real threat underneath, from Europe's hacked supermarket fridges to AI that breaks in within hours, and what experts say would contain it.
cover_alt: Breaking, not ending: the week the systems failed. A navy-to-dusk sky over a city skyline, with the KKReckons special report kicker.

title: Lift-off, with turbulence: India's next 161 unicorns
dek: 161 Indian startups on the runway to $1 billion: the jobs, the deep tech, the money behind them and the failures.
blurb: India now has 161 startups on the runway to $1 billion, and more of them make rockets, chips and solar modules than apps. The jobs, the government's ₹1 lakh crore RDI fund and the investors backing them, the collapses that say not all will make it, and a watchlist of 70 deep-tech startups.

title: Wall Street to brunch: Claude's wins, on Anthropic's word. Who checked?
dek: 26 Claude use cases from Anthropic's S-1, the measured gains, and the evidence that cuts the other way.
blurb: Anthropic's IPO filing shows Claude inside 26 organisations, from AIG's underwriters to a Boston brunch kitchen. What it saved, where the gains are biggest, and what the numbers can't tell you.

title: Popped or leaking? The AI bubble in October 2026
dek: China's AI shares have crashed while America's boom leaks through credit: neocloud debt, Gartner's $4.9tn revenue gap, history, hedges and the India angle.
